entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri Avinash Sirpurkar, Senior Advocate along with Shri 
 Advocate for the applicant.
Shri K K Tiwari - GA appearing on behalf of Advocate Gen  ORDER 1] They are heard.

2] This is the first bail applications filed by applicant under Section 483 BHARTIYA NAGRIK SURAKSHA SANHITA, 2023/ section 439 of Cr.P.C. as he is implicated in connection with Crime No.149/2024 registered at Police Station M.G.
Road, District Indore (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 474,
120-B, and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

entities.text:
Police Station M.G.
Road, District Indore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 3.5.2024.
3] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that there is no recovery effected from the present applicant and that the other co-accused persons have already been granted bail by this Court.
It is further submitted that the applicant is in jail since 3/5/2024 and the final conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.

Thus, it is prayed that the application of the applicant deserves to be allowed.
4] Counsel for the state has opposed the prayer.
However, it is not denied the other co-accused persons have already been granted bail by this Court.

5] Having considered the rival submissions, perusal of the case diary, and in the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:17411 2 MCRC-704-2025 light of the order dated 30/07/2024 passed in the case of co-accused Sunil in M.Cr.C. No.29044/2024, in the case of Bhupendra in Rahul Badera vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102866858/

entities.text: Rahul Badera vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 M.Cr.C. No.36319/2024 vide order dated 10/9/2024, in the case of Rajkumar Salvi passed in MCRC.No.39749/2024 vide order dated 25/9/2024 and in the case of Rameshwar Parmar passed in MCRC.No.44082/2024 vide order dated 25/10/2024 whereby they have been granted bail

and also taking note of the fact that there is no recovery effected from the present applicant and also the fact that the applicant is in jail since more than one and half year and the final conclusion of the trial is likely to take sufficient long time, in the considered opinion of this Court, the applicant's application deserves to be allowed.
6. Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
7. MCRC stands allowed and disposed of.
(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE das Rahul Badera vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102866858/
